Kukkonen, S. (2017). Energy consumption analysis of battery electric vehicles in underground environments. In: Hudyma, M. and Potvin, Y. (eds), Underground Mining Technology 2017, Sudbury, Canada. Australian Centre for Geomechanics, Perth, pp. 569-580. https://doi.org/10.36487/ACG_rep/1710_46_Kukkonen

Paper covers ancillary underground vehicles (concrete transport and spraying, emulsion charging), NOT ore haulage trucks, so the haul-truck archetypes do not fit; the vehicles map to the generic battery-electric mobile equipment. Loaded: driveline efficiency, battery size, energy per km on the level for four vehicle weights. Slope and regeneration tables, process powers and charging notes are in _other-values. No capex, opex, lifetime or diesel comparison is given (only the qualitative diesel/Li-ion energy density). Locator: printed page numbers (569-580; PDF page 1 = p.569). Traps: unit is kWh per vehicle-km, not per tonne or per GJ; the 90 kWh battery is a simulation assumption; Fig. 1 percentages are cumulative remaining energy by stage and the last step (88 to 83) shows 6 % loss.
